narrative: The MCP CVE wave quantifies the broad, unmanaged authorization gap the prediction's premise rests on: nine of VIPER-MCP's 67 CVEs trace to broken OAuth, a Censys scan counts 12,520 mostly-unauthenticated services, and roughly 40% of remote servers expose tools with no auth at all. That measures the wholesale-OAuth exposure but is not an identity provider acting on it.
remaining_gap: No SSO provider - Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace - has carved out a distinct AI-extension OAuth scope category; vulnerability research is not the landing.
